title: Доказать JCS по pinned independent oracle и differential corpus
summary: Расширить JCS gate до независимого RFC/upstream oracle, 10 000 deterministic number cases, UTF-16/Unicode/raw-invalid boundaries и byte-level PHP/Dart receipts.
why: Current focused suites are green but mostly share a small golden corpus; two SDKs can agree on the same serialization defect, especially around IEEE-754 formatting and UTF-16 ordering. RFC 8785 defines those boundaries explicitly. `RAG:✅` in `@plan/knowledge/research-P6-design-rag.json`.

include: Exact upstream commit/provenance/license; six upstream input/output/outhex cases; bounded 10k number corpus/checksum; PHP/Dart oracle drivers; UTF-16 BMP/non-BMP ordering; escaped controls; no Unicode normalization; raw duplicate/invalid surrogate/malformed-number cases; NaN/infinity rejection; byte-diff diagnostics; successor fixtures and deterministic report.
exclude: Treating PHP or Dart as oracle; network at test time; 100M-number mandatory gate; cryptographic algorithm redesign; event/token hash ownership; runtime Node dependency; changing RFC semantics to match an SDK; fuzz/mutation depth owned by P8.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Vendor only declared upstream files with path, commit, SHA-256 and license provenance. Expected bytes originate from the pinned oracle/RFC, never an SDK. The 10k corpus must match upstream checksum before use. Raw invalid cases reach `canonicalizeJson` without a parser normalizing duplicates first. Reports compare UTF-8 bytes and show first differing offset plus digests. No BOM/newline is added. Network is forbidden in normal validation. If an SDK cannot represent an I-JSON number exactly, reject before semantic hashing rather than round silently. 100M remains optional P8 evidence.
guidance: Stream number cases to bound memory. Keep oracle data separate from product fixtures but copy digest-qualified expected rows into the successor corpus. Preserve negative raw bytes as files. A minimized failing case is diagnostic output, not an automatically rewritten golden.
deliverables: Pinned licensed independent JCS oracle, bounded high-depth corpus, PHP/Dart byte-level receipts and deterministic mismatch report.
